title: Improve Visual Feedback for Add-to-Cart Actions

scenarios: Debouncing: Rapid clicks within 100ms send only 1 request
updateCartBadge: Updates DOM cart count correctly
Error handling: Shows error toast on network failure
Button state: Correctly toggles loading/enabled states
Input validation: Rejects invalid quantity/productId
Toast component renders with correct message and type
Button shows/hides spinner during loading
Cart badge animation triggers on update
Loading state persists until response received
Full flow: Click button → Fetch → CartService call → Update badge
Error recovery: Service failure → Retry button → Retry succeeds
Cross-origin: CORS headers correct for /api/cart/add endpoint
Session handling: CartService receives correct session cookie

scenarios.name: User sees confirmation after adding product to cart
User sees error when CartService unavailable
steps: Verify cart badge does NOT update

scenarios.name: Button provides visual feedback during request
Rapid button clicks are debounced
steps: Verify only 1 request was sent to server

scenarios.name: Screen reader announces cart addition
steps: Navigate with keyboard to Add To Cart button

scenarios: ARIA live region exists and updates on cart change
Button has aria-busy attribute that reflects loading state
Toast has role='status' and aria-live='assertive'
Keyboard navigation: Tab through product page, Enter to add
Focus management: Focus returns to button after toast dismisses
Color contrast: Toast text meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio
Screen reader: All interactive elements announced correctly
Product page with no cart items
Product page with items in cart
Button in idle state
Button in loading state (spinner visible)
Success toast notification
Error toast notification
Cart badge: 0, 1, 5, 10+ items
Mobile viewport: button layout, toast positioning
Tablet viewport: same as mobile
Desktop viewport: full layout
